# Comparison browser fixtures

Metadata and dimension responses use a synthetic native contract: dataset identity, revision and transform hash are test values. Unit member 9685 is used consistently in metadata and observation fixtures. Display labels/values retain earlier fixture examples and are not evidence of current data or correct source aggregation.

The observation fixture still exercises the comparison consumer's existing wire shape. This metadata migration does not certify complete native source-vector comparison, geographic identity, default classification selection or production readiness. Those remain separate migration gates.
